title: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda at day 100: an ESCMID Emerging Infections Subcommittee update.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has challenged epidemic control despite rapid expansion of response capacity. OBJECTIVES: To reassess the threats identified by the ESCMID Emerging Infections Subcommittee at day 100 and identify clinical and public-health priorities. SOURCES: This narrative update draws on published literature and WHO, Africa CDC, ECDC, and national public health reports, using 22 August 2026 as the day-100 analytical cut-off, with data through 20 October for a subsequent update. CONTENT: By 22 August, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths in 57 health zones across six provinces, making it the largest recorded outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak by confirmed case count. Uganda contained 20 cases, and its outbreak was declared over on 27 August. By 20 October, the DRC had reported 9704 cases and 4687 deaths in 66 health zones across eight provinces; Kenya had reported nine epidemiologically linked cases and Nigeria one. Contact follow-up improved, but many transmission chains remained unidentified. BDBV-specific diagnostics, therapeutic and post-exposure prophylaxis trials, and vaccine studies expanded, yet no vaccine or virus-specific treatment had demonstrated clinical efficacy. Cross-reactive antibody responses after licensed Ebola vaccination do not establish protection against BDBV. ECDC assessed infection likelihood for EU/EEA residents as very low. IMPLICATIONS: Epidemic control requires complete contact tracing complemented by active case-finding, earlier referral, high-quality supportive care, health-worker protection, community engagement, flexible financing and preservation of essential health services.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, assessing its impact and identifying clinical and public-health priorities. By 22 August 2026, the DRC had reported 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths, marking the largest recorded outbreak in the country. Despite expanded research efforts, no vaccine or virus-specific treatment had demonstrated clinical efficacy. The review underscores the need for improved contact tracing, active case-finding, and supportive care. It also notes that cross-reactive antibody responses from Ebola vaccination do not provide protection against BDBV. The ECDC assessed the infection likelihood for EU/EEA residents as very low. The review highlights the importance of maintaining essential health services and community engagement during outbreaks.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 尽管反应能力迅速扩大,但刚果民主共和国(DRC)和乌干达的2026年本迪布焦病毒病(BVD)ZX​​QTERMXQXZ仍对疫情控制构成挑战。此次审查旨在重新评估 ESCMID 新发感染小组委员会在第 100 天确定的威胁,并确定临床和公共卫生优先事项。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本叙述性更新借鉴了已发表的文献以及世界卫生组织、非洲疾病预防控制中心、欧洲疾病预防控制中心和国家公共卫生报告,使用 2026 年 8 月 22 日作为第 100 天的分析截止日期,并提供截至 10 月 20 日的数据以供后续更新。接触者追踪有所改善,但许多 传播 连锁店的身份仍然不明。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 截至 8 月 22 日,刚果民主共和国已报告 6 个省 57 个卫生区的 5514 例确诊病例和 2642 例死亡,成为刚果民主共和国有记录的最大病例数,也是确诊病例数第二大的埃博拉病例数。BDBV 特异性诊断、治疗和暴露后预防试验以及 疫苗 研究扩大,但尚无 疫苗 或病毒特异性 治疗 证明临床疗效。流行病控制需要完整的接触者追踪,辅以积极的病例发现、早期转诊、高质量的支持性护理、卫生工作者保护、社区参与、灵活的融资和保留基本卫生服务。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查指出,获得许可的埃博拉 疫苗接种 后的交叉反应抗体反应并不能建立针对 BDBV 的保护作用。ECDC 评估欧盟/欧洲经济区居民感染的可能性非常低。所提供的证据并未报告针对 BDBV 的交叉反应抗体反应的有效性或 传播 的具体机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调了 BDBV 特异性诊断、治疗和暴露后预防试验以及 疫苗 研究的必要性。它还强调了完整的接触者追踪、积极的病例发现、早期转诊、高质量的支持性护理、卫生工作者保护、社区参与、灵活的融资和保留基本卫生服务对流行病控制的重要性。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查指出,获得许可的埃博拉 疫苗接种 后的交叉反应抗体反应并不能建立针对 BDBV 的保护作用。ECDC 评估欧盟/欧洲经济区居民感染的可能性非常低。所提供的证据并未报告针对 BDBV 的交叉反应抗体反应的有效性或 传播 的具体机制。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调了 BDBV 特异性诊断、治疗和暴露后预防试验以及 疫苗 研究的必要性。它还强调了完整的接触者追踪、积极的病例发现、早期转诊、高质量的支持性护理、卫生工作者保护、社区参与、灵活的融资和保留基本卫生服务对流行病控制的重要性。

title: Cross-neutralization of Bundibugyo virus following Ebola virus booster vaccination
abstract: Background: The ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) highlights the absence of a licensed Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) vaccine. Ebola virus (EBOV) vaccines can induce cross-reactive BDBV binding antibodies, but evidence of cross-neutralizing antibodies is limited. Methods: In the EBO-BOOST trial ( NCT06126822 ), previously EBOV-vaccinated adults received an ERVEBO booster after primary vaccination with ERVEBO (E|E, n=60) or ZABDENO/MVABEA (Zm|E, n=40). Neutralizing antibodies against EBOV and BDBV were measured at baseline, day 21 (D21) and month 6 (M6) using biologically contained EBOV-dVP30-eGFP and BDBV-dVP30-eGFP reporter viruses. Results: BDBV seropositivity increased from 8% at baseline to 67% at D21, declining to 34% at M6. Median NT50 titers were significantly lower for BDBV than for EBOV at D21 (40.9 vs 244.1; P<0.001) and at M6 (<20 vs 66.5; P<0.001). In mixed-effects models adjusted for time since primary vaccination, BDBV responses were 65% lower than EBOV responses at D21 (GMR 0.35; 95% CI 0.26-0.48) and 50% lower at M6 (GMR 0.50; 95% CI 0.40-0.63). The Zm|E group showed a higher BDBV fold change from baseline at D21 than the E|E group (GMR 1.75; p=0.023). Conclusions: An ERVEBO booster induces BDBV cross-neutralizing antibodies in most recipients, but responses are lower than against EBOV and largely wane by 6 months. Although protective significance and correlates of protection remain to be established, these findings support evaluation of ERVEBO in parallel with BDBV-specific vaccines.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the cross-neutralization of Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) following an Ebola virus (EBOV) booster vaccination. The ongoing BVD outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) underscores the need for a BDBV vaccine, as current EBOV vaccines may induce cross-reactive antibodies. The EBO-BOOST trial evaluated previously EBOV-vaccinated adults who received an ERVEBO booster after primary vaccination with ERVEBO or ZABDENO/MVABEA. Neutralizing antibodies against EBOV and BDBV were measured using reporter viruses at baseline, day 21, and month 6. Results showed that BDBV seropositivity increased significantly after the booster, but median NT50 titers were lower than those for EBOV. The Zm|E group demonstrated a higher BDBV fold change from baseline at day 21 compared to the E|E group. These findings suggest that ERVEBO can induce BDBV cross-neutralizing antibodies, though responses are lower than against EBOV and decline over time. The study supports further evaluation of ERVEBO alongside BDBV-specific vaccines, but protective significance and correlates of protection remain to be determined.

title_zh: 埃博拉病毒 加强剂 疫苗接种 后本迪布焦病毒的交叉中和
source_body_en: Background: The ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) highlights the absence of a licensed Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) vaccine. Ebola virus (EBOV) vaccines can induce cross-reactive BDBV binding antibodies, but evidence of cross-neutralizing antibodies is limited. Methods: In the EBO-BOOST trial ( NCT06126822 ), previously EBOV-vaccinated adults received an ERVEBO booster after primary vaccination with ERVEBO (E|E, n=60) or ZABDENO/MVABEA (Zm|E, n=40). Neutralizing antibodies against EBOV and BDBV were measured at baseline, day 21 (D21) and month 6 (M6) using biologically contained EBOV-dVP30-eGFP and BDBV-dVP30-eGFP reporter viruses. Results: BDBV seropositivity increased from 8% at baseline to 67% at D21, declining to 34% at M6. Median NT50 titers were significantly lower for BDBV than for EBOV at D21 (40.9 vs 244.1; P<0.001) and at M6 (<20 vs 66.5; P<0.001). In mixed-effects models adjusted for time since primary vaccination, BDBV responses were 65% lower than EBOV responses at D21 (GMR 0.35; 95% CI 0.26-0.48) and 50% lower at M6 (GMR 0.50; 95% CI 0.40-0.63). The Zm|E group showed a higher BDBV fold change from baseline at D21 than the E|E group (GMR 1.75; p=0.023). Conclusions: An ERVEBO booster induces BDBV cross-neutralizing antibodies in most recipients, but responses are lower than against EBOV and largely wane by 6 months. Although protective significance and correlates of protection remain to be established, these findings support evaluation of ERVEBO in parallel with BDBV-specific vaccines.

title: Five Decades of Ebola Virus Disease in Africa (1976–2026): Exploring Outbreak Trends, Mortality Patterns, Transmission, and Epidemiological Dynamics—A Retrospective Study
abstract: Background Ebola virus disease (EVD) remains one of the most severe viral hemorrhagic fevers affecting Africa, causing recurrent outbreaks with substantial morbidity, mortality, and socioeconomic disruption. Despite five decades of documented outbreaks, comprehensive assessments of long-term epidemiological trends across the continent remain limited. This study investigated outbreak trends, mortality patterns, and epidemiological dynamics of EVD in Africa from 1976 to 2026. Methods A retrospective epidemiological analysis of publicly available WHO, CDC, and other credible surveillance and scientific data was conducted to characterize Ebola outbreaks by year, country, region, virus species, duration, cases, deaths, and case fatality rate (CFR). Descriptive statistics, Kruskal–Wallis tests, Mann–Kendall trend analysis, Sen’s slope estimation, and Poisson regression were used to assess outbreak characteristics, temporal trends, and changes in annual outbreak frequency. Results A total of 41 human EVD outbreaks were identified across Africa between 1976 and 2026, with outbreak frequency increasing progressively from three outbreaks during 1976–1986 to fourteen outbreaks during 2017–2026. Poisson regression demonstrated a significant increase in outbreak occurrence over time (incidence rate ratio [IRR] = 1.04, 95% CI: 1.02–1.07, p < 0.001), corresponding to an estimated 48% increase in outbreak frequency per decade. Mann–Kendall analysis revealed a significant decline in outbreak-related fatalities over time (τ = −0.242, p = 0.032; Sen’s slope = − 0.80), while trends in cases, outbreak duration, and CFR were not statistically significant. Central Africa recorded the highest median CFR (71.0%), with a significant overall difference across regions ( p = 0.027), although pairwise post hoc comparisons were not significant Orthoebolavirus zairense accounted for the majority of outbreaks (68.3%) and exhibited the highest median CFR (70.8%), although pairwise species comparisons were not statistically significant following post hoc testing. Conclusion These findings underscore the need for sustained investment in EVD surveillance, preparedness, rapid outbreak response, and resilient healthcare systems across Africa, particularly in Central Africa, to strengthen prevention and control efforts and reduce outbreak-associated mortality.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 仍然是影响非洲最严重的病毒性出血热之一,导致 暴发 复发,发病率很高,死亡率 和社会经济受到破坏。尽管已有五年的 暴发 记录,但对整个非洲大陆长期流行病学趋势的综合评估仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了 1976 年至 2026 年非洲埃博拉病毒病的 暴发 趋势、暴发 模式和流行病学动态。1976 年至 2026 年间,非洲各地共发现了 41 例人类埃博拉病毒病 暴发,暴发 频率从 1976 年至 1986 年期间的 3 个 暴发 逐渐增加到2017 年至 2026 年期间有 14 个 暴发。
elements_zh.methods: 对公开的 WHO、CDC 和其他可靠的 暴发 和科学数据进行回顾性流行病学分析,按年份、国家、地区、病毒种类、持续时间、病例、死亡人数和病死率 (CFR) 来描述埃博拉病毒 暴发 的特征。使用描述性统计、Kruskal-Wallis 检验、Mann-Kendall 趋势分析、Sen 斜率估计和泊松回归来评估 暴发 特征、时间趋势和年度 暴发 频率的变化。
elements_zh.main_results: Poisson regression demonstrated a significant increase in outbreak occurrence over time (incidence rate ratio [IRR] = 1.04, 95% CI: 1.02–1.07, p < 0.001), corresponding to an estimated 48% increase in outbreak frequency per decade.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Mann-Kendall 分析显示,随着时间的推移,暴发 相关死亡人数显着下降(τ = −0.242,p = 0.032;Sen 斜率 = − 0.80),而病例趋势、暴发 持续时间和 CFR 没有统计学意义。中部非洲的病死率中位数最高 (71.0%),各地区总体差异显着 (p = 0.027),但两两事后比较并不显着。扎伊尔正埃博拉病毒占 暴发 的大部分 (68.3%),并表现出最高的中位病死率 (70.8%),尽管事后测试后两对物种比较没有统计学意义。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些调查结果强调,需要在整个非洲,特别是中部非洲,对埃博拉病毒病暴发、准备工作、快速暴发响应和有弹性的医疗保健系统进行持续投资,以加强预防和控制工作并减少与暴发相关的暴发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据不报告设计限制、偏差、混杂因素、样本量、对照、普遍性或仅抽象证据。由于该研究依赖于公开的 监测 数据且不包括主要数据收集,因此证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.methods: 对公开的 WHO、CDC 和其他可靠的 暴发 和科学数据进行回顾性流行病学分析,按年份、国家、地区、病毒种类、持续时间、病例、死亡人数和病死率 (CFR) 来描述埃博拉病毒 暴发 的特征。使用描述性统计、Kruskal-Wallis 检验、Mann-Kendall 趋势分析、Sen 斜率估计和泊松回归来评估 暴发 特征、时间趋势和年度 暴发 频率的变化。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Mann-Kendall 分析显示,随着时间的推移,暴发 相关死亡人数显着下降(τ = −0.242,p = 0.032;Sen 斜率 = − 0.80),而病例趋势、暴发 持续时间和 CFR 没有统计学意义。中部非洲的病死率中位数最高 (71.0%),各地区总体差异显着 (p = 0.027),但两两事后比较并不显着。扎伊尔正埃博拉病毒占 暴发 的大部分 (68.3%),并表现出最高的中位病死率 (70.8%),尽管事后测试后两对物种比较没有统计学意义。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些调查结果强调,需要在整个非洲,特别是中部非洲,对埃博拉病毒病暴发、准备工作、快速暴发响应和有弹性的医疗保健系统进行持续投资,以加强预防和控制工作并减少与暴发相关的暴发。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据不报告设计限制、偏差、混杂因素、样本量、对照、普遍性或仅抽象证据。由于该研究依赖于公开的 监测 数据且不包括主要数据收集,因此证据强度中等。

title: Targeting host eIF4A with zotatifin inhibits Bundibugyo virus and other filoviruses
abstract: Abstract Filoviruses, including Ebola and Marburg viruses, depend on host eIF4A helicase activity for replication. Zotatifin is a first-in-class, clinical-stage eIF4A inhibitor that acts as a molecular glue, stabilizing the interaction between eIF4A and selected polypurine-rich RNA sequences, thereby inhibiting RNA unwinding and ribosomal scanning. Here, we identify pronounced polypurine enrichment in the 5′ untranslated regions (5′ UTRs) of the seven major filoviral protein-coding genes NP, VP35, VP40, GP, VP30, VP24, and L across four virus species, including Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). Consistent with these findings, zotatifin inhibits the replication of Ebola, Marburg, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Bundibugyo viruses at low-nanomolar concentrations. Zotatifin has been administered to humans in oncology and COVID-19 clinical studies. Clinical pharmacokinetic–pharmacodynamic (PK–PD) modeling indicates that exposures resulting in inhibition of BDBV replication are achievable in humans at tolerated doses following subcutaneous administration. Together, these findings support the repurposing of zotatifin as a host-directed antiviral candidate against BDBV and other filoviruses, with potential applications in preparedness for future outbreaks. Highlights Zotatifin targets host eIF4A to inhibit filovirus replication. Conserved polypurine-rich motifs in filoviral 5′ UTRs are putative sites for zotatifin-induced eIF4A clamping. Zotatifin suppresses EBOV, TAFV, SUDV, MARV and BDBV replication at 6.25 nM in vitro, with IC50 and IC90 values of 1.0–3.5 nM for EBOV, MARV and BDBV. Monte Carlo simulation with a population PK model built from COVID-19 patient data identified subcutaneous zotatifin regimens that keep concentrations above the BDBV IC 90 for ≥50% of the dosing interval in 540,000 virtual pediatric and adult subjects. Predicted exposures for these regimens fall within those achieved with subcutaneous doses tolerated in patients with COVID-19.

Here, we identify pronounced polypurine enrichment in the 5′ untranslated regions (5′ UTRs) of the seven major filoviral protein-coding genes NP, VP35, VP40, GP, VP30, VP24, and L across four virus species, including Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). Consistent with these findings, zotatifin inhibits the replication of Ebola, Marburg, Sudan, Taï Forest, and Bundibugyo viruses at low-nanomolar concentrations. Zotatifin has been administered to humans in oncology and COVID-19 clinical studies. Clinical pharmacokinetic–pharmacodynamic (PK–PD) modeling indicates that exposures resulting in inhibition of BDBV replication are achievable in humans at tolerated doses following subcutaneous administration. Together, these findings support the repurposing of zotatifin as a host-directed antiviral candidate against BDBV and other filoviruses, with potential applications in preparedness for future outbreaks. Highlights Zotatifin targets host eIF4A to inhibit filovirus replication. Conserved polypurine-rich motifs in filoviral 5′ UTRs are putative sites for zotatifin-induced eIF4A clamping. Zotatifin suppresses EBOV, TAFV, SUDV, MARV and BDBV replication at 6.25 nM in vitro, with IC50 and IC90 values of 1.0–3.5 nM for EBOV, MARV and BDBV. Monte Carlo simulation with a population PK model built from COVID-19 patient data identified subcutaneous zotatifin regimens that keep concentrations above the BDBV IC 90 for ≥50% of the dosing interval in 540,000 virtual pediatric and adult subjects. Predicted exposures for these regimens fall within those achieved with subcutaneous doses tolerated in patients with COVID-19.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Filoviruses, including Ebola and Marburg viruses, depend on host eIF4A helicase activity for replication. This study aimed to identify potential targets for antiviral intervention by examining the interaction between eIF4A and filoviral RNA sequences.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 丝状病毒,包括埃博拉病毒和马尔堡病毒,依赖于 宿主 eIF4A 解旋酶活性进行复制。本研究旨在通过检查 eIF4A 和丝状病毒 RNA 序列之间的相互作用来确定 抗病毒药物 干预的潜在靶点。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了包括本迪布焦病毒 (BDBV) 在内的四种病毒物种的 7 个主要丝状病毒蛋白编码基因的 5' 非翻译区 (5' UTR)。它还在体外评估了 Zotatifin 对多种丝状病毒的 抗病毒药物 作用,并使用药代动力学模型评估其在人类中的潜力。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员在丝状病毒基因的 5' UTR 中鉴定出富含多嘌呤的序列,并测试了佐他芬抑制 RNA 解旋和核糖体扫描的能力。他们进行了体外实验来测量 抗病毒药物 活性,并使用蒙特卡罗模拟和群体药代动力学模型来预测人类暴露情况。
elements_zh.main_results: Zotatifin 在低纳摩尔浓度下可抑制埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒、苏丹病毒、塔伊森林病毒和本迪布焦病毒的复制。在体外,它以 6.25 nM 的浓度抑制 EBOV、TAFV、SUDV、MARV 和 BDBV 复制,EBOV、MARV 和 BDBV 的 IC50 和 IC90 值为 1.0–3.5 nM。药代动力学模型表明,在 540,000 名虚拟受试者中,皮下注射佐他替芬方案可以在≥50%的给药间隔内将浓度维持在 BDBV IC90 以上。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,zotatifin 的作用机制是针对 宿主 eIF4A,可有效对抗多种丝状病毒,包括 BDBV。这支持了其作为未来 暴发 的 宿主 定向 抗病毒药物 候选者的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为重新利用佐他替芬作为针对 BDBV 和其他丝状病毒的治疗选择奠定了基础,增强了 暴发 的准备并为 抗病毒药物 的开发提供了新的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于体外数据和药代动力学模型,可能无法完全反映体内条件。然而,证据是强有力的,多种丝状病毒和基于耐受剂量的可达到的人体暴露结果一致。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,zotatifin 的作用机制是针对 宿主 eIF4A,可有效对抗多种丝状病毒,包括 BDBV。这支持了其作为未来 暴发 的 宿主 定向 抗病毒药物 候选者的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为重新利用佐他替芬作为针对 BDBV 和其他丝状病毒的治疗选择奠定了基础,增强了 暴发 的准备并为 抗病毒药物 的开发提供了新的策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于体外数据和药代动力学模型,可能无法完全反映体内条件。然而,证据是强有力的,多种丝状病毒和基于耐受剂量的可达到的人体暴露结果一致。

title: Ervebo Vaccine Provides Cross-Protection Against Bundibugyo Virus Infection in Macaques
abstract: Abstract The 2026 Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) was declared a public health emergency (PHEIC) in May 2026 (1). Regional security concerns, debilitated medical infrastructure, diagnostic limitations, and lack of approved BDBV–specific medical countermeasures have contributed to rapid escalation of the outbreak (2). Currently, there are no licensed medical countermeasures for BDBV (3). Several BDBV-specific vaccines are in development (4), including a vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV)–based vaccine expressing the BDBV glycoprotein which has demonstrated strong preclinical efficacy (5-7); however, these candidates have not yet completed clinical evaluation. A licensed VSV-based vaccine expressing the Ebola virus glycoprotein (VSV-EBOV) (8) is available for human use and clinical (ERVEBO) and research grade (VSV-EBOV) material has been shown to elicit cross-reactive, cross-neutralizing and inconclusive cross-protective immune responses against the related BDBV (5,9-14). ERVEBO’s protective efficacy against BDBV, however, has not been formally established in the standard macaque model of BDBV infection. Macaques received a single human dose of ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine and were challenged with BDBV 14 days after vaccination. ERVEBO vaccinated macaques exhibited significantly reduced clinical disease and strikingly increased survival, as well as significantly reduced viremia, mucosal viral shedding and disease-associated biochemistry markers consistent with protection against BDBV-mediated hepatorenal disease. These findings indicate that ERVEBO can rapidly mediate cross-protective immunity against BDBV.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate whether the ERVEBO vaccine, originally developed for Ebola virus disease, could provide cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection. The 2026 BDBV disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) was declared a public health emergency (PHEIC) in May 2026, highlighting the need for effective countermeasures.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a standard macaque model of BDBV infection. Macaques received a single human dose of ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine and were challenged with BDBV 14 days after vaccination.
analysis.methods: The researchers used a single human dose of ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine in macaques, then challenged them with BDBV 14 days post-vaccination. They assessed clinical disease, survival, viremia, mucosal viral shedding, and disease-associated biochemistry markers.
analysis.main_results: ERVEBO vaccinated macaques exhibited significantly reduced clinical disease and strikingly increased survival, as well as significantly reduced viremia, mucosal viral shedding, and disease-associated biochemistry markers consistent with protection against BDBV-mediated hepatorenal disease.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that ERVEBO can rapidly mediate cross-protective immunity against BDBV, which is a novel demonstration of its potential utility in the context of related viral threats.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that ERVEBO may offer a valuable tool for cross-protection against BDBV, which could inform future vaccine development and public health strategies for managing outbreaks of related viruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is limited to a single human dose and a macaque model, which may not fully represent human immune responses. However, the results are based on direct observations in a relevant animal model, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether the ERVEBO vaccine, developed for Ebola virus disease, could provide cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection in macaques. The 2026 BDBV outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompted the need for effective countermeasures. Macaques were vaccinated with ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine and then challenged with BDBV. The results showed that ERVEBO significantly reduced clinical disease, increased survival, and decreased viremia and disease markers in vaccinated animals. These findings suggest ERVEBO may offer cross-protection against BDBV, which could have implications for managing related viral outbreaks. However, the study is limited to a single human dose and a macaque model, which may not fully reflect human immune responses. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估最初为 埃博拉病毒病 开发的 ERVEBO 疫苗 是否可以提供针对本迪布焦病毒 (BDBV) 感染的交叉保护。刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 的 2026 BDBV 疾病 暴发 于 2026 年 5 月被宣布为突发公共卫生事件 (PHEIC),凸显了采取有效对策的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在 BDBV 感染的标准猕猴模型中进行的。猕猴接受单剂量人类剂量的 ERVEBO 或不相关的基于 VSV 的对照 疫苗,并在 疫苗接种 后 14 天接受 BDBV 攻击。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员在猕猴身上使用了单剂量的 ERVEBO 或基于 VSV 的不相关对照 疫苗,然后在 疫苗接种 后 14 天用 BDBV 对其进行攻击。他们评估了临床疾病、生存率、病毒血症、粘膜病毒脱落和疾病相关的生化标志物。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate whether the ERVEBO vaccine, originally developed for Ebola virus disease, could provide cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection. The 2026 BDBV disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) was declared a public health emergency (PHEIC) in May 2026, highlighting the need for effective countermeasures.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a standard macaque model of BDBV infection. Macaques received a single human dose of ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine and were challenged with BDBV 14 days after vaccination.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers used a single human dose of ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine in macaques, then challenged them with BDBV 14 days post-vaccination. They assessed clinical disease, survival, viremia, mucosal viral shedding, and disease-associated biochemistry markers.
analysis_en.main_results: ERVEBO vaccinated macaques exhibited significantly reduced clinical disease and strikingly increased survival, as well as significantly reduced viremia, mucosal viral shedding, and disease-associated biochemistry markers consistent with protection against BDBV-mediated hepatorenal disease.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that ERVEBO can rapidly mediate cross-protective immunity against BDBV, which is a novel demonstration of its potential utility in the context of related viral threats.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that ERVEBO may offer a valuable tool for cross-protection against BDBV, which could inform future vaccine development and public health strategies for managing outbreaks of related viruses.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is limited to a single human dose and a macaque model, which may not fully represent human immune responses. title_zh: Ervebo 疫苗 为猕猴提供针对 Bundibugyo 病毒感染的交叉保护
source_body_en: Abstract The 2026 Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) was declared a public health emergency (PHEIC) in May 2026 (1). Regional security concerns, debilitated medical infrastructure, diagnostic limitations, and lack of approved BDBV–specific medical countermeasures have contributed to rapid escalation of the outbreak (2). Currently, there are no licensed medical countermeasures for BDBV (3). Several BDBV-specific vaccines are in development (4), including a vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV)–based vaccine expressing the BDBV glycoprotein which has demonstrated strong preclinical efficacy (5-7); however, these candidates have not yet completed clinical evaluation. A licensed VSV-based vaccine expressing the Ebola virus glycoprotein (VSV-EBOV) (8) is available for human use and clinical (ERVEBO) and research grade (VSV-EBOV) material has been shown to elicit cross-reactive, cross-neutralizing and inconclusive cross-protective immune responses against the related BDBV (5,9-14). ERVEBO’s protective efficacy against BDBV, however, has not been formally established in the standard macaque model of BDBV infection. Macaques received a single human dose of ERVEBO or an unrelated VSV-based control vaccine and were challenged with BDBV 14 days after vaccination. ERVEBO vaccinated macaques exhibited significantly reduced clinical disease and strikingly increased survival, as well as significantly reduced viremia, mucosal viral shedding and disease-associated biochemistry markers consistent with protection against BDBV-mediated hepatorenal disease. These findings indicate that ERVEBO can rapidly mediate cross-protective immunity against BDBV.

title: Knowledge, self-estimated risks and training participation surrounding infection prevention and control of COVID-19 and Ebola Disease among healthcare workers in Rwanda: a cross-sectional study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rwanda has not only been affected by the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic and a Marburg Disease (MARD) outbreak in 2024 but is also regularly confronted with outbreaks of Ebola Disease (EBOD) in neighboring countries. To better target preparedness activities, this study aimed to assess infection prevention and control (IPC) and clinical competence of health care workers (HCW) in five districts of Rwanda. METHODS: In this cross-sectional study, 215 HCWs in 26 health centers and eight hospitals in Kigali and the districts Rubavu and Nyamagabe were selected by multistage sampling and answered a questionnaire containing 84 items about clinical and IPC-related aspects of COVID-19 and EBOD. We assessed HCW knowledge as weighted scores (proportion of achieved points), and analyzed self-estimated risk, training participation and associations with demographic and occupational factors. RESULTS: Of 215 participants, 22 (10.2%) were physicians and 193 (89.8%) paramedical professionals, 133 (61.9%) employed in district hospitals and 82 (38.1%) in health centers. Participation in IPC trainings was reported by 133 (61.9%) participants, more frequently by males (48/65, 73.8%) than females (85/150, 56.7%; adjusted Prevalence Ratio (aPR) 1.31, 95%CI 1.07-1.61). HCWs in hospitals reported higher amount of training days than HCWs in health centers (p = 0.001). Most frequently mentioned sources for health information were social media (29%) and TV & Radio (27%). Participants achieved a mean total knowledge score of 61.1% (SD 7.16), with higher results in Kigali (62.4%, SD 7.1), for COVID-19-related questions (62.5%, SD 8.2) and for questions on practical IPC implementation (75.6%, SD 10.4), p < 0.001. Regarding COVID-19, 182 (84.7%) rated their IPC knowledge as good or very good while only 95 (44.2%) stated this for EBOD. Self-assessed ability to avoid infection was perceived "possible" or "very well possible" by 172 (80%) regarding SARS-CoV and 123 (57.2%) regarding EBOD. CONCLUSION: HCWs showed overall moderate to good knowledge, independently from demographic and professional factors. Higher scores regarding practical IPC implementation vs. additional medical knowledge and more recent vs. past clinical experiences underline the need of regular refresher trainings. Health information activities should use digital channels in the future and promote gender equity in access to training.

METHODS: In this cross-sectional study, 215 HCWs in 26 health centers and eight hospitals in Kigali and the districts Rubavu and Nyamagabe were selected by multistage sampling and answered a questionnaire containing 84 items about clinical and IPC-related aspects of COVID-19 and EBOD. We assessed HCW knowledge as weighted scores (proportion of achieved points), and analyzed self-estimated risk, training participation and associations with demographic and occupational factors. RESULTS: Of 215 participants, 22 (10.2%) were physicians and 193 (89.8%) paramedical professionals, 133 (61.9%) employed in district hospitals and 82 (38.1%) in health centers. Participation in IPC trainings was reported by 133 (61.9%) participants, more frequently by males (48/65, 73.8%) than females (85/150, 56.7%; adjusted Prevalence Ratio (aPR) 1.31, 95%CI 1.07-1.61). HCWs in hospitals reported higher amount of training days than HCWs in health centers (p = 0.001). Most frequently mentioned sources for health information were social media (29%) and TV & Radio (27%). Participants achieved a mean total knowledge score of 61.1% (SD 7.16), with higher results in Kigali (62.4%, SD 7.1), for COVID-19-related questions (62.5%, SD 8.2) and for questions on practical IPC implementation (75.6%, SD 10.4), p < 0.001. Regarding COVID-19, 182 (84.7%) rated their IPC knowledge as good or very good while only 95 (44.2%) stated this for EBOD. Self-assessed ability to avoid infection was perceived "possible" or "very well possible" by 172 (80%) regarding SARS-CoV and 123 (57.2%) regarding EBOD. CONCLUSION: HCWs showed overall moderate to good knowledge, independently from demographic and professional factors. Higher scores regarding practical IPC implementation vs. additional medical knowledge and more recent vs. past clinical experiences underline the need of regular refresher trainings. Health information activities should use digital channels in the future and promote gender equity in access to training.

title: RNA folding drives species-dependent host mRNA partitioning in Ebola virus condensates.
abstract: RNA viruses form membraneless condensates in host cells to drive replication, but whether these compartments regulate host RNAs remains unclear. Using multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization (MERFISH)-based subcellular transcriptomics, we quantified cellular mRNA recruitment into Ebola virus condensates under basal and interferon (IFN)-stimulated states. We find that, in the basal state, cellular RNAs with minimally folded coding regions are selectively recruited. Under IFN stimulation, however, IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) with structured 3' UTRs concentrate in viral condensates. We find that both RNA structural features are conserved in the viral genome and support its retention in condensates. In parallel, for cellular mRNAs, we find that partitioning into condensates prolongs RNA half-life and amplifies, rather than dampens, ISG expression. Fruit bats, which do not experience severe disease from RNA viruses, instead have ISGs with reduced 3' UTR folding and may evade condensate sequestration, thus enabling balanced antiviral responses. This selective stabilization links condensate function to RNA regulation as a molecular determinant of virus-host co-evolution and disease pathogenesis.

title_zh: RNA 折叠驱动 宿主 mRNA 在 埃博拉病毒 凝聚物中的分配。
source_body_en: RNA viruses form membraneless condensates in host cells to drive replication, but whether these compartments regulate host RNAs remains unclear. Using multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization (MERFISH)-based subcellular transcriptomics, we quantified cellular mRNA recruitment into Ebola virus condensates under basal and interferon (IFN)-stimulated states. We find that, in the basal state, cellular RNAs with minimally folded coding regions are selectively recruited. Under IFN stimulation, however, IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) with structured 3' UTRs concentrate in viral condensates. We find that both RNA structural features are conserved in the viral genome and support its retention in condensates. In parallel, for cellular mRNAs, we find that partitioning into condensates prolongs RNA half-life and amplifies, rather than dampens, ISG expression. Fruit bats, which do not experience severe disease from RNA viruses, instead have ISGs with reduced 3' UTR folding and may evade condensate sequestration, thus enabling balanced antiviral responses. This selective stabilization links condensate function to RNA regulation as a molecular determinant of virus-host co-evolution and disease pathogenesis.
abstract_zh: RNA病毒在宿主细胞中形成无膜凝聚物以驱动复制,但这些区室是否调节宿主 RNA仍不清楚。使用基于多重误差鲁棒性荧光原位杂交 (MERFISH) 的亚细胞转录组学,我们量化了在基础状态和干扰素 (IFN) 刺激状态下 埃博拉病毒 冷凝物中细胞 mRNA 的募集情况。我们发现,在基础状态下,具有最小折叠编码区的细胞 RNA 被选择性地招募。然而,在 IFN 刺激下,具有结构化 3' UTR 的 IFN 刺激基因 (ISG) 集中在病毒凝聚物中。我们发现这两种 RNA 结构特征在病毒 基因组 中都是保守的,并支持其在凝聚物中的保留。与此同时,对于细胞 mRNA,我们发现分离成凝聚物可以延长 RNA 半衰期,并放大而不是抑制 ISG 表达。果蝠不会因 RNA 病毒而罹患严重疾病,而是具有 3' UTR 折叠减少的 ISG,并可能逃避冷凝物封存,从而实现平衡的 抗病毒药物 反应。这种选择性稳定作用将凝结物功能与 RNA 调节联系起来,作为病毒-宿主 co-进化 和疾病 发病机制 的分子决定因素。

title: Perceived contributions of malaria mass drug administration to the 2022 Ebola virus disease response in Uganda: a qualitative study of implementation experiences and lessons learned
abstract: In regions with a high malaria burden, overlapping symptoms, such as fever, complicate case detection, surveillance, and response to outbreaks of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). During the 2022 Ebola Sudan Virus Disease (SVD) outbreak in Uganda’s Mubende and Kassanda districts, clinically differentiating febrile illnesses proved challenging and potentially delayed Ebola case identification and increased exposure risk. This paper documents stakeholders’ perceptions of the contribution of, and the facilitators and barriers to, Mass Drug Administration (MDA) for malaria during the outbreak in Mubende and Kassanda districts, Uganda. This was a qualitative descriptive study involving 30 key informant interviews with health workers, local leaders, and implementers alongside 10 focus group discussions with community members and community health workers (CHWs). Data were transcribed, translated, and thematically analyzed. The MDA, delivered primarily door-to-door by trained community health workers with some fixed-site distribution at health facilities in the most affected sub-counties in late 2022, used dihydroartemisinin–piperaquine and was described from programme documents and participant accounts. The intervention was perceived to reduce malaria cases and deaths and to minimize syndromic overlap between malaria and Ebola, particularly in private clinics where reduced Ebola exposure was reported by study participants. Key facilitators included trained CHWs conducting house-to-house sensitization, strong partner support, and active engagement of local leaders to enhance community participation. Major barriers included public distrust of government programs and negative community perceptions of the intervention, limited drug supply, and location of some fixed distribution points near Ebola isolation facilities. Stakeholders perceived that malaria MDA contributed to reductions in malaria cases and deaths, eased the perceived differentiation of febrile illness during Ebola triage, by reducing the background burden of malaria-related fever, though it did not replace individual diagnostic testing, and supported continuity of access to malaria services during the outbreak. Implementation depended on community trust, adequate logistics, partner support, and the active involvement of CHWs and trusted community leaders. These qualitative findings do not establish the epidemiological effectiveness of MDA, but they offer operational lessons for considering malaria MDA within outbreak preparedness frameworks in high-malaria-burden settings, where its use should be guided by WHO recommendations, local epidemiology, feasibility, and safety.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在疟疾负担高的地区,症状重叠,例如发烧,病例检测、监测 以及对 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 的 暴发 的反应变得复杂。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2022 年乌干达穆本德和卡桑达地区爆发苏丹埃博拉病毒病 (SVD) 暴发 期间,临床区分发热性疾病具有挑战性,可能会延迟埃博拉病例的识别并增加暴露风险。
elements_zh.methods: 这是一项定性描述性研究,涉及对卫生工作者、地方领导人和实施者进行 30 次关键信息访谈,以及与社区成员和社区卫生工作者 (CHW) 进行的 10 次焦点小组讨论。数据被转录、翻译并进行主题分析。
elements_zh.main_results: MDA 主要由训练有素的社区卫生工作者挨家挨户提供,并于 2022 年底在受影响最严重的县的卫生机构进行固定地点分发,使用双氢青蒿素-哌喹,并在计划文件和参与者账户中进行了描述。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 利益相关者认为,疟疾 MDA 有助于减少疟疾病例和死亡,通过减少疟疾相关发热的背景负担,缓解埃博拉分诊期间发热性疾病的感知差异,尽管它并没有取代个人诊断检测,并支持在 暴发 期间继续获得疟疾服务。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些定性研究结果并未确定 MDA 的流行病学有效性,但它们为在疟疾高负担地区的 暴发 防备框架内考虑疟疾 MDA 提供了操作经验,其使用应遵循 WHO 建议、当地 流行病学、可行性和安全性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告调查结果的统计强度,但它强调了实施取决于社区信任、充足的后勤、合作伙伴的支持以及社区卫生工作者和值得信赖的社区领袖的积极参与。

title_zh: 疟疾大规模药物管理对乌干达 2022 年 埃博拉病毒病 应对措施的贡献:对实施经验和教训的定性研究
source_body_en: In regions with a high malaria burden, overlapping symptoms, such as fever, complicate case detection, surveillance, and response to outbreaks of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). During the 2022 Ebola Sudan Virus Disease (SVD) outbreak in Uganda’s Mubende and Kassanda districts, clinically differentiating febrile illnesses proved challenging and potentially delayed Ebola case identification and increased exposure risk. This paper documents stakeholders’ perceptions of the contribution of, and the facilitators and barriers to, Mass Drug Administration (MDA) for malaria during the outbreak in Mubende and Kassanda districts, Uganda. This was a qualitative descriptive study involving 30 key informant interviews with health workers, local leaders, and implementers alongside 10 focus group discussions with community members and community health workers (CHWs). Data were transcribed, translated, and thematically analyzed. The MDA, delivered primarily door-to-door by trained community health workers with some fixed-site distribution at health facilities in the most affected sub-counties in late 2022, used dihydroartemisinin–piperaquine and was described from programme documents and participant accounts. The intervention was perceived to reduce malaria cases and deaths and to minimize syndromic overlap between malaria and Ebola, particularly in private clinics where reduced Ebola exposure was reported by study participants. Key facilitators included trained CHWs conducting house-to-house sensitization, strong partner support, and active engagement of local leaders to enhance community participation. Major barriers included public distrust of government programs and negative community perceptions of the intervention, limited drug supply, and location of some fixed distribution points near Ebola isolation facilities. Stakeholders perceived that malaria MDA contributed to reductions in malaria cases and deaths, eased the perceived differentiation of febrile illness during Ebola triage, by reducing the background burden of malaria-related fever, though it did not replace individual diagnostic testing, and supported continuity of access to malaria services during the outbreak. Implementation depended on community trust, adequate logistics, partner support, and the active involvement of CHWs and trusted community leaders. These qualitative findings do not establish the epidemiological effectiveness of MDA, but they offer operational lessons for considering malaria MDA within outbreak preparedness frameworks in high-malaria-burden settings, where its use should be guided by WHO recommendations, local epidemiology, feasibility, and safety.
abstract_zh: 在疟疾负担高的地区,症状重叠,例如发烧,病例检测、监测 以及对 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 的 暴发 的反应变得复杂。2022 年乌干达穆本德和卡桑达地区爆发苏丹埃博拉病毒病 (SVD) 暴发 期间,临床区分发热性疾病具有挑战性,可能会延迟埃博拉病例的识别并增加暴露风险。本文记录了利益相关者对乌干达穆本德和卡桑达地区 暴发 期间疟疾大众药物管理局 (MDA) 的贡献、促进因素和障碍的看法。这是一项定性描述性研究,涉及对卫生工作者、地方领导人和实施者进行 30 次关键信息访谈,以及与社区成员和社区卫生工作者 (CHW) 进行的 10 次焦点小组讨论。数据被转录、翻译并进行主题分析。MDA 主要由训练有素的社区卫生工作者挨家挨户提供,并于 2022 年底在受影响最严重的县的卫生机构进行固定地点分发,使用双氢青蒿素-哌喹,并在计划文件和参与者账户中进行了描述。该干预措施被认为可以减少疟疾病例和死亡,并最大限度地减少疟疾和埃博拉之间的症状重叠,特别是在研究参与者报告的埃博拉暴露减少的私人诊所。主要推动者包括经过培训的社区卫生工作者进行挨家挨户的宣传、强有力的合作伙伴支持以及当地领导人的积极参与以增强社区参与。主要障碍包括公众对政府计划的不信任、社区对干预措施的负面看法、药物供应有限以及埃博拉隔离设施附近的一些固定分发点。利益相关者认为,疟疾 MDA 有助于减少疟疾病例和死亡,通过减少疟疾相关发热的背景负担,缓解埃博拉分诊期间发热性疾病的感知差异,尽管它并没有取代个人诊断检测,并支持在 暴发 期间继续获得疟疾服务。实施取决于社区信任、充足的后勤、合作伙伴的支持以及社区卫生工作者和值得信赖的社区领袖的积极参与。这些定性研究结果并未确定 MDA 的流行病学有效性,但它们为在疟疾高负担地区的 暴发 防备框架内考虑疟疾 MDA 提供了操作经验,其使用应遵循 WHO 建议、当地 流行病学、可行性和安全性。

title: Elucidating the Effect that Ebola Virus Matrix Protein VP40 Mutations have on Matrix Assembly and Host Cell Lipid Interactions
abstract: The Ebola virus (EBOV) matrix protein, VP40, is the primary driver of viral assembly and egress, a process fundamentally dependent on its ability to traffic to the inner leaflet of the host plasma membrane (PM) and assemble into higher-order oligomers. VP40 dimerizes in the cytoplasm and will traffic to the PM, where the C-terminal domain (CTD) facilitates initial interaction, lipid binding, and higher order oligomerization required for viral budding. The interactions between the structural surfaces of VP40 as well as the key drivers behind VP40 mechanisms remain poorly understood. This thesis investigates these dynamic interactions and VP40 mechanisms by evaluating natural viral mutations from major outbreaks alongside targeted computational mutagenesis of key structural residues. First, we analyzed natural CTD mutations identified in patient samples from the 2013–2016 West African (S228G, G226R, Q245R, K256R) and 2018–2020 Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) (D312G, K274N, S228C, and S228N)EBOV outbreaks to determine how naturally evolving viral sequences alter protein activity and host cell interactions. Mutations that increased the net positive charge (+1) of the protein (G226R, Q245R, and D312G) significantly enhanced PM localization, though this did not uniformly translate to increased virus-like particle (VLP) budding efficiency for Q245R or D312G. Conversely, serine mutations (S228C/G/N) maintained standard PM localization. Unexpectedly, the charge-decreasing mutation K274N (-1) significantly increased PM localization and trended toward higher VLP budding. These natural variants demonstrate a distinct disconnect between initial PM recruitment and the stable lipid or protein-protein interactions required for viral egress. To further elucidate dimer-dimer interactions at the PM, we studied CTD residue lysine (K) 326 using molecular dynamics simulations, computational site-saturation mutagenesis, and in vitro assays. K326 is predicted to play a critical role in stabilizing the interfaces of higher-order structures like tetramers and hexamers. Experimental mutation of this residue to alanine (K326A) or aspartic acid (K326D) significantly impaired PM localization and completely abrogated VLP production. This indicates that cationic residue at this position is crucial not only for binding anionic lipids but for forming stabilizing interactions across VP40 dimer-dimer interfaces. These findings identify K326 as a keystone residue for both membrane binding and higher-order oligomerization, while also demonstrating how natural evolutionary mutations modify VP40 activity to alter interactions with host cells.

title_zh: 阐明 埃博拉病毒 基质蛋白 VP40 突变 对基质组装和 宿主 细胞脂质相互作用的影响
source_body_en: The Ebola virus (EBOV) matrix protein, VP40, is the primary driver of viral assembly and egress, a process fundamentally dependent on its ability to traffic to the inner leaflet of the host plasma membrane (PM) and assemble into higher-order oligomers. VP40 dimerizes in the cytoplasm and will traffic to the PM, where the C-terminal domain (CTD) facilitates initial interaction, lipid binding, and higher order oligomerization required for viral budding. The interactions between the structural surfaces of VP40 as well as the key drivers behind VP40 mechanisms remain poorly understood. This thesis investigates these dynamic interactions and VP40 mechanisms by evaluating natural viral mutations from major outbreaks alongside targeted computational mutagenesis of key structural residues. First, we analyzed natural CTD mutations identified in patient samples from the 2013–2016 West African (S228G, G226R, Q245R, K256R) and 2018–2020 Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) (D312G, K274N, S228C, and S228N)EBOV outbreaks to determine how naturally evolving viral sequences alter protein activity and host cell interactions. Mutations that increased the net positive charge (+1) of the protein (G226R, Q245R, and D312G) significantly enhanced PM localization, though this did not uniformly translate to increased virus-like particle (VLP) budding efficiency for Q245R or D312G. Conversely, serine mutations (S228C/G/N) maintained standard PM localization. Unexpectedly, the charge-decreasing mutation K274N (-1) significantly increased PM localization and trended toward higher VLP budding. These natural variants demonstrate a distinct disconnect between initial PM recruitment and the stable lipid or protein-protein interactions required for viral egress. To further elucidate dimer-dimer interactions at the PM, we studied CTD residue lysine (K) 326 using molecular dynamics simulations, computational site-saturation mutagenesis, and in vitro assays. K326 is predicted to play a critical role in stabilizing the interfaces of higher-order structures like tetramers and hexamers. Experimental mutation of this residue to alanine (K326A) or aspartic acid (K326D) significantly impaired PM localization and completely abrogated VLP production. This indicates that cationic residue at this position is crucial not only for binding anionic lipids but for forming stabilizing interactions across VP40 dimer-dimer interfaces. These findings identify K326 as a keystone residue for both membrane binding and higher-order oligomerization, while also demonstrating how natural evolutionary mutations modify VP40 activity to alter interactions with host cells.

title: Implementation of Risk Communication Tabletop Exercise and Areas for Improvement: A Case Study on the Office of the Spokesperson, Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Although risk communication is essential to infectious disease crisis response, in the Republic of Korea, infectious disease crisis management exercises have mainly focused on field response procedures, with few exercises specifically addressing risk communication. This paper describes the implementation of a risk communication tabletop exercise developed and conducted by the Office of the Spokesperson at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and presents the identified improvement tasks and implications. METHODS: The World Health Organization's Simulation Exercise Manual (2017) was used to develop a discussion-based tabletop exercise using Ebola virus disease and avian influenza scenarios. The exercise aimed to evaluate risk communication procedures at each crisis alert level, clarify team roles and external cooperation systems, and identify improvement areas. The exercise simulated escalating crisis alert levels through a spokesperson-led communication review meeting, followed by post-exercise discussion. RESULTS: Briefing procedures, centralized press inquiry channels, misinformation and disinformation monitoring procedures, and communication channels for external cooperation operated smoothly during the exercise. In areas where standards and roles had not been sufficiently specified, ad hoc responses were observed. The exercise identified areas for improvement in emergency communication content, public campaigns, press communication, implementation of external cooperation, and personnel and organizational operations. CONCLUSIONS: Repeated peacetime exercises can strengthen risk communication. This case may provide a basis for developing evaluation frameworks, expanding participation, and promoting the standardization and institutionalization of risk communication exercises.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the implementation of risk communication tabletop exercises in the context of infectious disease crisis management, particularly in the Republic of Korea. The central question is how to improve risk communication procedures during public health emergencies, with an emphasis on the Office of the Spokesperson at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency. The topic boundary is limited to risk communication exercises and their evaluation, with the target entities being Ebola viruses and related diseases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review describes a discussion-based tabletop exercise developed using the World Health Organization's Simulation Exercise Manual (2017). It used scenarios involving Ebola virus disease and avian influenza to simulate escalating crisis alert levels. The exercise involved a spokesperson-led communication review meeting followed by post-exercise discussions. The methods included evaluating risk communication procedures at each alert level, clarifying team roles, and identifying improvement areas.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The exercise found that briefing procedures, centralized press inquiry channels, misinformation monitoring, and external cooperation communication channels operated smoothly. However, areas where standards and roles were not sufficiently specified led to ad hoc responses. The review concludes that repeated peacetime exercises can strengthen risk communication and that this case may provide a basis for developing evaluation frameworks and promoting the standardization of risk communication exercises.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while some procedures were effective, there were gaps in the specification of standards and roles, leading to ad hoc responses. It also notes that the exercise identified areas for improvement in emergency communication content, public campaigns, press communication, and organizational operations. These findings suggest a need for more detailed protocols and better coordination mechanisms.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends the development of evaluation frameworks for risk communication exercises, expanding participation in such exercises, and promoting the standardization and institutionalization of risk communication practices. It also emphasizes the importance of clarifying team roles and external cooperation systems to ensure effective and consistent communication during public health crises.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the implementation of a risk communication tabletop exercise conducted by the Office of the Spokesperson at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency. The exercise, based on the World Health Organization's Simulation Exercise Manual, used scenarios involving Ebola virus disease and avian influenza to simulate crisis alert levels. It identified strengths in briefing procedures, press inquiry channels, and external cooperation communication, but also highlighted gaps in role specification and standardization. The review concludes that repeated peacetime exercises can enhance risk communication and suggests the need for improved frameworks and institutionalization of these practices. Key implications include the development of evaluation tools, expanded participation, and better coordination mechanisms to address communication challenges during infectious disease outbreaks.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 此次审查的重点是在传染病危机管理背景下实施风险沟通桌面演习,特别是在韩国。核心问题是如何改进突发公共卫生事件期间的风险沟通程序,重点是韩国疾病管理和预防局发言人办公室。主题边界仅限于风险沟通练习及其评估,目标实体为埃博拉病毒及相关疾病。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论描述了使用世界卫生组织的模拟练习手册(2017 年)开发的基于讨论的桌面练习。它使用涉及 埃博拉病毒病 和禽流感的场景来模拟不断升级的危机警报级别。此次演习包括由发言人主导的沟通审查会议,以及演习后的讨论。这些方法包括评估每个警报级别的风险沟通程序、明确团队角色以及确定改进领域。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 演练发现,通报程序、新闻集中询问渠道、虚假信息监测、对外合作沟通渠道运行平稳。然而,标准和角色未充分明确的领域导致了临时响应。审查的结论是,平时反复进行演习可以加强风险沟通,该案例可以为制定评估框架和促进风险沟通演习的标准化提供基础。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查强调,虽然一些程序是有效的,但在标准和角色的规范方面存在差距,导致采取临时应对措施。它还指出,演习确定了应急通信内容、公共活动、新闻传播和组织运作方面需要改进的领域。这些发现表明需要更详细的协议和更好的协调机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查建议制定风险沟通活动评估框架,扩大风险沟通活动的参与范围,推动风险沟通实践的标准化和制度化。它还强调了明确团队角色和外部合作系统的重要性,以确保公共卫生危机期间有效和一致的沟通。

title_zh: 风险沟通桌面练习的实施和需要改进的领域:以韩国疾病管理和预防机构发言人办公室为例。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: Although risk communication is essential to infectious disease crisis response, in the Republic of Korea, infectious disease crisis management exercises have mainly focused on field response procedures, with few exercises specifically addressing risk communication. This paper describes the implementation of a risk communication tabletop exercise developed and conducted by the Office of the Spokesperson at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and presents the identified improvement tasks and implications. METHODS: The World Health Organization's Simulation Exercise Manual (2017) was used to develop a discussion-based tabletop exercise using Ebola virus disease and avian influenza scenarios. The exercise aimed to evaluate risk communication procedures at each crisis alert level, clarify team roles and external cooperation systems, and identify improvement areas. The exercise simulated escalating crisis alert levels through a spokesperson-led communication review meeting, followed by post-exercise discussion. RESULTS: Briefing procedures, centralized press inquiry channels, misinformation and disinformation monitoring procedures, and communication channels for external cooperation operated smoothly during the exercise. In areas where standards and roles had not been sufficiently specified, ad hoc responses were observed. The exercise identified areas for improvement in emergency communication content, public campaigns, press communication, implementation of external cooperation, and personnel and organizational operations. CONCLUSIONS: Repeated peacetime exercises can strengthen risk communication. This case may provide a basis for developing evaluation frameworks, expanding participation, and promoting the standardization and institutionalization of risk communication exercises.
abstract_zh: 目标:尽管风险沟通对于传染病危机应对至关重要,但在韩国,传染病危机管理演习主要集中在现场应对程序,很少有专门针对风险沟通的演习。本文介绍了韩国疾病控制和预防局发言人办公室开发和开展的风险沟通桌面演习的实施情况,并介绍了已确定的改进任务和影响。方法:根据世界卫生组织的模拟练习手册(2017 年),使用 埃博拉病毒病 和禽流感场景开发基于讨论的桌面练习。此次演习旨在评估每个危机警报级别的风险沟通程序,明确团队角色和外部合作体系,并确定需要改进的领域。此次演习通过发言人主导的沟通审查会议模拟了不断升级的危机警报级别,随后进行了演习后讨论。结果:演习期间通报程序、新闻集中询问渠道、错误信息和虚假信息监测程序以及对外合作沟通渠道运行顺利。在标准和作用尚未充分明确的领域,采取了临时应对措施。此次演习确定了应急通信内容、公众宣传、新闻传播、对外合作实施、人员和组织运作等方面需要改进的领域。结论:平时反复演习可以加强风险沟通。该案例可为制定评估框架、扩大参与范围、促进风险沟通活动的标准化和制度化提供依据。

title: Tools without trust: public health diplomacy and the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in East Africa
abstract: Public health emergencies test relationships as much as laboratories. On 15 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) confirmed an outbreak of Bundibugyo virus in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, and the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 17 May (1,2). As of 2 September 2026, the DRC epidemic had reached 6,342 confirmed cases and 3,072 confirmed deaths (2). Uganda, by contrast, had successfully interrupted transmission, and both the World Health Organization and Uganda's Ministry of Health subsequently declared the outbreak over. Nevertheless, Uganda continued to face travel-related restrictions, prompting Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya to call for their removal at the July 2026 African Union health summit (3). His argument, that countries should not be penalized for transparent reporting, names the gap this editorial addresses. We use public health diplomacy narrowly: the standing legal and institutional arrangements between neighboring states and their regional bloc that let cross-border response operate under political stress. The trust at stake is the confidence of Ministries of Health that transparent reporting will result in regional support rather than unilateral penalties. The International Health Regulations (IHR) (2005) expectation of rapid notification is not always matched by protection from its economic and political consequences. Public health diplomacy of this regional kind must be built as peacetime infrastructure, not improvised in an emergency.That gap is legal, and its consequences extend well beyond data governance. Cross-border surveillance scholarship distinguishes four interoperability dimensions on which such a response depends: technical, semantic, organizational, and legal (4). In the Bundibugyo response, East notification. Africa CDC's August 2024 mpox declaration showed that regional incentive structures 65 can reward early notification (5). Kaseya's Ghana appeal articulated the political imperative. If countries that comply with international reporting obligations continue to bear disproportionate 67 costs, the credibility of the global outbreak notification system may be eroded.

abstract_zh: 突发公共卫生事件对人际关系的考验不亚于对实验室的考验。2026 年 5 月 15 日,刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 在伊图里省蒙布瓦卢确认了本迪布焦病毒 暴发,世界卫生组织于 5 月 17 日宣布国际关注的突发公共卫生事件 (PHEIC) (1,2)。截至 2026 年 9 月 2 日,刚果民主共和国疫情已达 6,342 例确诊病例和 3,072 例死亡病例 (2)。相比之下,乌干达成功中断了传播,世界卫生组织和乌干达卫生部随后宣布暴发结束。尽管如此,乌干达继续面临与旅行相关的限制,促使非洲疾病预防控制中心总干事让·卡塞亚 (Jean Kaseya) 在 2026 年 7 月的非洲联盟卫生峰会上呼吁取消这些限制 (3)。他的论点是,各国不应因透明报告而受到惩罚,这正是这篇社论所要解决的问题。我们狭隘地使用公共卫生外交:邻国及其区域集团之间的长期法律和制度安排,使跨境应对措施能够在政治压力下运作。所面临的信任是卫生部的信心,即透明的报告将带来区域支持而不是单方面惩罚。《国际卫生条例》(IHR)(2005)对快速通报的期望并不总是与对其经济和政治后果的保护相匹配。这种区域性的公共卫生外交必须作为和平时期的基础设施来建设,而不是在紧急情况下临时搭建。这种差距是合法的,其后果远远超出了数据治理的范围。跨境 监测 学术区分了此类响应所依赖的四个互操作性维度:技术、语义、组织和法律 (4)。在本迪布焦回应中,东通知。非洲疾病预防控制中心 2024 年 8 月的 MPOX 声明显示,区域激励结构 65 可以奖励早期通知 (5)。卡塞亚向加纳发出的呼吁阐明了政治必要性。如果遵守国际报告义务的国家继续承担不成比例的 67 成本,全球 暴发 通报系统的可信度可能会受到削弱。

title: APC Injury: A Hypothesis That Dendritic-Cell Impairment Allows Persistent Viral Antigen and Loss of Self-Tolerance After Infection
abstract: After an acute infection, the immune system can fail in two directions at once. It may fail to clear viral material that does not belong, allowing antigen or RNA to persist in tissue, and it may fail to tolerate self, producing autoantibodies. Failure to clear antigen is not the same as immunological tolerance of it. This article proposes that injury to antigen-presenting cells, chiefly dendritic cells (APC Injury), can help explain both failures after SARS-CoV-2. Acute COVID-19 commonly depletes circulating conventional and plasmacytoid dendritic cells. Remaining cells can be poor at co-stimulation or at producing interferon when challenged. After the acute illness, findings diverge: some long COVID cohorts show fewer cDC1s or more activated pDCs, others no major blood dendritic-cell depletion. Tissue studies show that altered dendritic-cell frequencies and retained viral antigen can coexist, but not that one causes the other. Autoantibodies appear in some assays and not in others. No published study has measured dendritic-cell function, tissue antigen, and self-antigen-specific regulatory T-cell or autoantibody outcomes in the same patients. Ebola virus can persist for months to years in privileged sites, and Ebola proteins can block dendritic-cell maturation in vitro. That analogy supports a testable model, not a proof in long COVID. A longitudinal study should measure dendritic-cell function, tissue viral material, and incident or changing autoreactivity in the same participants, with recovered controls, treating self-antigen-specific regulatory T-cell function as the mechanistic intermediate rather than as a substitute outcome. The model's central testable implication is temporal: a defined dendritic-cell functional defect should precede and predict both persistent antigen and new autoreactivity in the same people, rather than following either. A reduced residual association between the two outcomes after the defect and relevant common causes are accounted for would be consistent with the model, but would not uniquely identify it, because separate pathways with shared upstream causes can also produce correlated outcomes. No therapeutic claim follows until the affected subset, the impaired function, the tissue compartment, and the direction of correction have been identified.

Tissue studies show that altered dendritic-cell frequencies and retained viral antigen can coexist, but not that one causes the other. Autoantibodies appear in some assays and not in others. No published study has measured dendritic-cell function, tissue antigen, and self-antigen-specific regulatory T-cell or autoantibody outcomes in the same patients. Ebola virus can persist for months to years in privileged sites, and Ebola proteins can block dendritic-cell maturation in vitro. That analogy supports a testable model, not a proof in long COVID. A longitudinal study should measure dendritic-cell function, tissue viral material, and incident or changing autoreactivity in the same participants, with recovered controls, treating self-antigen-specific regulatory T-cell function as the mechanistic intermediate rather than as a substitute outcome. The model's central testable implication is temporal: a defined dendritic-cell functional defect should precede and predict both persistent antigen and new autoreactivity in the same people, rather than following either. A reduced residual association between the two outcomes after the defect and relevant common causes are accounted for would be consistent with the model, but would not uniquely identify it, because separate pathways with shared upstream causes can also produce correlated outcomes. No therapeutic claim follows until the affected subset, the impaired function, the tissue compartment, and the direction of correction have been identified.

analysis.methods: The methods involve a theoretical framework based on existing evidence of dendritic-cell depletion and dysfunction in acute COVID-19, as well as in vitro studies showing how Ebola proteins can block dendritic-cell maturation. source_body_en: After an acute infection, the immune system can fail in two directions at once. abstract_zh: 急性感染后,免疫系统可能会同时向两个方向失效。它可能无法清除不属于的病毒物质,从而使抗原或RNA持续存在于组织中,并且它可能无法耐受自身,产生自身抗体。未能清除抗原并不等同于对其的免疫耐受。本文提出,抗原呈递细胞(主要是树突状细胞)的损伤(APC 损伤)有助于解释 SARS-CoV-2 后的这两种失败。急性 COVID-19 通常会消耗循环的常规树突状细胞和浆细胞样树突状细胞。其余细胞在受到挑战时可能不擅长共刺激或产生干扰素。急性疾病发生后,研究结果出现分歧:一些长期的 COVID 队列研究 显示出较少的 cDC1 或更多的激活的 pDC,而另一些则没有出现严重的血液树突状细胞耗竭。组织研究表明,改变的树突状细胞频率和保留的病毒抗原可以共存,但不是其中一种导致另一种。自身抗体出现在某些检测中,而在其他检测中则不出现。目前尚无已发表的研究测量同一患者的树突状细胞功能、组织抗原和自身抗原特异性调节性 T 细胞或自身抗体的结果。埃博拉病毒 可以在特殊部位持续数月至数年,而埃博拉蛋白可以在体外阻止树突状细胞的成熟。这个类比支持的是一个可测试的模型,而不是长期新冠病毒的证明。纵向研究应测量同一参与者的树突状细胞功能、组织病毒物质以及事件或变化的自身反应性,并恢复对照,将自身抗原特异性调节性 T 细胞功能视为机械中间体而不是替代结果。该模型的中心可测试含义是时间性的:确定的树突状细胞功能缺陷应该先于并预测同一个人的持久性抗原和新的自身反应性,而不是跟随其中任何一个。考虑缺陷和相关共同原因后,两个结果之间的残余关联性减少将与模型一致,但不能唯一地识别它,因为具有共享上游原因的单独路径也可以产生相关结果。在确定受影响的亚群、受损的功能、组织区室和纠正方向之前,不会提出任何治疗主张。

title: Viral Pathogens as Global Health Threats: Review of Transmissibility, Lethality, and Pandemic Potential
abstract: Viral pathogens vary substantially in their transmissibility, lethality, and potential to cause widespread epidemics or pandemics. Measles, for example, is exceptionally contagious but has relatively low case fatality in populations with access to modern medical care. Conversely, rabies, Nipah virus, Ebola virus, and Marburg virus can cause severe disease with high case fatality rates but generally exhibit limited sustained human-to-human transmission. The greatest global threats, therefore, are not necessarily the most contagious or lethal viruses, but those that combine efficient transmission, substantial clinical severity, zoonotic reservoirs, evolutionary adaptability, and limited preventive or therapeutic options. The COVID-19 pandemic illustrated this convergence of risk factors, demonstrating how efficient transmission, including presymptomatic and asymptomatic spread, coupled with clinically significant disease can produce devastating global consequences. Influenza A viruses remain a major pandemic concern because of their extensive animal reservoirs, capacity for antigenic evolution, and established history of human pandemics. Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) is particularly concerning given the high case fatality observed among confirmed human cases, although sustained human-to-human transmission has not been established. In contrast, henipaviruses and filoviruses pose substantial clinical threats because of their high lethality, despite comparatively limited transmissibility. This review critically examines major viral threats through three interconnected determinants of global health risk: transmissibility, infection fatality risk, and the biological and epidemiological factors governing their epidemic and pandemic potential.

source_records.abstract: Viral pathogens vary substantially in their transmissibility, lethality, and potential to cause widespread epidemics or pandemics. Measles, for example, is exceptionally contagious but has relatively low case fatality in populations with access to modern medical care. Conversely, rabies, Nipah virus, Ebola virus, and Marburg virus can cause severe disease with high case fatality rates but generally exhibit limited sustained human-to-human transmission. The greatest global threats, therefore, are not necessarily the most contagious or lethal viruses, but those that combine efficient transmission, substantial clinical severity, zoonotic reservoirs, evolutionary adaptability, and limited preventive or therapeutic options. The COVID-19 pandemic illustrated this convergence of risk factors, demonstrating how efficient transmission, including presymptomatic and asymptomatic spread, coupled with clinically significant disease can produce devastating global consequences. Influenza A viruses remain a major pandemic concern because of their extensive animal reservoirs, capacity for antigenic evolution, and established history of human pandemics. Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) is particularly concerning given the high case fatality observed among confirmed human cases, although sustained human-to-human transmission has not been established. In contrast, henipaviruses and filoviruses pose substantial clinical threats because of their high lethality, despite comparatively limited transmissibility. This review critically examines major viral threats through three interconnected determinants of global health risk: transmissibility, infection fatality risk, and the biological and epidemiological factors governing their epidemic and pandemic potential.

abstract_zh: 病毒病原体的传播性、致死性以及引起广泛流行病或大流行的可能性差异很大。例如,麻疹具有极强的传染性,但在获得现代医疗护理的人群中病死率相对较低。相反,狂犬病、尼帕病毒、埃博拉病毒 和马尔堡病毒可引起严重疾病,病死率高,但通常表现出有限的持续人际传播 传播。因此,最大的全球威胁不一定是最具传染性或致命性的病毒,而是那些结合了高效的 传播、显着的临床严重性、人畜共患的 储存宿主、进化适应性和有限的预防或治疗选择的病毒。COVID-19大流行说明了风险因素的这种融合,证明了传播的有效性,包括症状前和无症状传播,再加上临床上重大疾病,可以产生毁灭性的全球后果。甲型流感病毒由于其广泛的动物 储存宿主、抗原 进化 的能力以及人类大流行的历史,仍然是主要的大流行问题。尽管尚未确定持续的人传人 传播,但鉴于在已确诊的人类病例中观察到高病死率,高致病性甲型禽流感 (H5N1) 尤其令人担忧。相比之下,亨尼帕病毒和丝状病毒尽管传播能力相对有限,但由于其高致死率而构成重大临床威胁。本综述通过全球健康风险的三个相互关联的决定因素批判性地审查了主要的病毒威胁:传播性、感染死亡风险以及控制其流行和大流行潜力的生物和流行病学因素。

title: Short-term changes following Ebola prevention training among Chinese Nationals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a single-group pre–post evaluation
abstract: Abstract Background During the 2026 outbreak of Ebola disease caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the 24th Chinese Medical Team to the DRC provided Ebola prevention training to Chinese nationals living or working in the country. This study evaluated short-term changes in Ebola-related knowledge, risk perception, psychological response, protective attitudes, and scenario-based protective behavioral intentions after training. Methods A single-group pre-post evaluation design was used. Five standardized in-person training sessions were combined with online electronic questionnaire assessments. The training covered Ebola virus disease (EVD) transmission and exposure management, hand hygiene, and personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and included knowledge instruction, procedural demonstrations, and supervised PPE donning and doffing practice. Of 200 trainees, 190 completed both the pre- and post-training online questionnaires. Domain scores were compared using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, and item-level correct response rates were compared using McNemar tests with Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate adjustment. Results After training, the score distributions of all five domains changed significantly (all P Conclusions Short-term changes were observed in questionnaire-based Ebola prevention outcomes within 1 week after training. These findings do not establish causal effects of the training or changes in actual behavior or objectively assessed practical competence. Infectivity during the incubation period and contamination prevention during PPE doffing remain priorities for future training.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估2026年刚果民主共和国埃博拉暴发培训后埃博拉相关知识、风险感知、心理反应、防护态度和基于情景的防护行为意图的短期变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用单组事前事后评价设计来评估200名中国公民培训后埃博拉预防结果的变化。
elements_zh.methods: 培训内容涵盖埃博拉病毒病 传播和暴露管理、手部卫生和个人防护装备的使用,包括知识指导、程序演示以及监督个人防护装备的穿脱实践。使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验比较领域分数,并使用 McNemar 检验与 Benjamini-Hochberg 错误发现率调整比较项目级正确响应率。
elements_zh.main_results: 训练后,所有五个领域均观察到显着变化(所有 P < 0.05)。

title: Managing occupational dermatitis during pandemics using virucidal emollient Dermol 500.
abstract: BackgroundWork-related contact dermatitis is a significant problem for healthcare workers. Repeated exposure to water, soap and alcohol-based gels can cause dry skin, irritation and contact dermatitis. Soap substitutes such as Dermol 500 are commonly prescribed to prevent and treat dermatitis. However, hand hygiene recommendations during the COVID-19 pandemic advised against using soap substitutes in clinical settings as their virucidal capacity had not been established. AimsTo investigate whether Dermol 500 lotion exhibits virucidal activity and is a suitable soap substitute for use during viral disease outbreaks. This study aims to inform best practice in occupational medicine and help combat the increased incidence of work-related contact dermatitis in clinical settings. MethodsThe virucidal activity of Dermol 500 lotion and its antimicrobial constituents benzalkonium chloride (BAK) and chlorhexidine dihydrochloride (CD) was assessed against influenza A virus (IAV), SARS-CoV-2 and pseudotyped viruses expressing glycoproteins from 2026 outbreak strains of Ebolavirus and Hantavirus. Viruses or pseudoviruses were incubated with treatment prior to quenching serial dilution and infectivity measurement by plaque assay, tissue culture infectious dose 50 (TCID50) or bioluminescent reporter activity. ResultsDermol 500 exhibits comparable virucidal activity to alcohol-based hand sanitisers against IAV and SARS-CoV-2. Furthermore, the Dermol 500 components BAK and CD exhibit independent and synergistic virucidal activity against IAV, SARS-CoV-2 and pseudoviruses. ConclusionsThe virucidal activity of Dermol 500 lotion and its active antimicrobials BAK and CD indicates its suitability as a soap substitute to treat and prevent contact dermatitis in front line workers during viral disease outbreaks. Teaser textOccupational dermatitis soared during the COVID-19 pandemic, but the standard treatment - the antimicrobial emollient and soap substitute Dermol 500 - was not recommended as its antiviral activity was unknown. Here, we address this evidence gap: Dermol 500 lotion is an effective virucide, and its constituents benzalkonium chloride (BAK) and chlorhexidine dihydrochloride (CD) effectively neutralise SARS-CoV-2, influenza A virus and pseudotyped 2026 strains of Ebolavirus and Hantavirus at concentrations 10-fold lower than the active formulation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景与工作相关的接触性皮炎是医护人员面临的一个重大问题。反复接触水、肥皂和酒精凝胶会导致皮肤干燥、刺激和接触性皮炎。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 方法评估了 Dermol 500 洗剂及其抗菌成分苯扎氯铵 (BAK) 和二盐酸氯己定 (CD) 对甲型流感病毒 (IAV)、SARS-CoV-2 以及表达埃博拉病毒和汉坦病毒 2026 暴发 株糖蛋白的假型病毒的杀病毒活性。
elements_zh.methods: 将病毒或假病毒与 治疗 一起孵育,然后通过噬菌斑测定、组织培养感染剂量 50 (TCID50) 或生物发光报告活性进行淬灭连续稀释和感染性测量。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果 Dermol 500 对 IAV 和 SARS-CoV-2 表现出与酒精类洗手液相当的杀病毒活性。此外,Dermol 500 成分 BAK 和 CD 对 IAV、SARS-CoV-2 和假病毒表现出独立和协同的杀病毒活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结论 Dermol 500 洗剂及其活性抗菌剂 BAK 和 CD 的杀病毒活性表明其适合作为肥皂替代品来治疗和预防病毒性疾病 暴发 期间一线工作人员的接触性皮炎。

ResultsDermol 500 exhibits comparable virucidal activity to alcohol-based hand sanitisers against IAV and SARS-CoV-2. Furthermore, the Dermol 500 components BAK and CD exhibit independent and synergistic virucidal activity against IAV, SARS-CoV-2 and pseudoviruses. ConclusionsThe virucidal activity of Dermol 500 lotion and its active antimicrobials BAK and CD indicates its suitability as a soap substitute to treat and prevent contact dermatitis in front line workers during viral disease outbreaks. Teaser textOccupational dermatitis soared during the COVID-19 pandemic, but the standard treatment - the antimicrobial emollient and soap substitute Dermol 500 - was not recommended as its antiviral activity was unknown. Here, we address this evidence gap: Dermol 500 lotion is an effective virucide, and its constituents benzalkonium chloride (BAK) and chlorhexidine dihydrochloride (CD) effectively neutralise SARS-CoV-2, influenza A virus and pseudotyped 2026 strains of Ebolavirus and Hantavirus at concentrations 10-fold lower than the active formulation.
abstract_zh: 背景与工作相关的接触性皮炎是医护人员面临的一个重大问题。反复接触水、肥皂和酒精凝胶会导致皮肤干燥、刺激和接触性皮炎。Dermol 500 等肥皂替代品通常用于预防和治疗皮炎。然而,COVID-19 大流行期间的手部卫生建议建议不要在临床环境中使用肥皂替代品,因为其杀病毒能力尚未确定。目的研究 Dermol 500 洗剂是否具有杀病毒活性,是否适合在病毒性疾病 暴发 期间使用肥皂替代品。本研究旨在为职业医学的最佳实践提供信息,并帮助对抗临床环境中与工作相关的接触性皮炎的增加。方法评估了 Dermol 500 洗剂及其抗菌成分苯扎氯铵 (BAK) 和二盐酸氯己定 (CD) 对甲型流感病毒 (IAV)、SARS-CoV-2 以及表达埃博拉病毒和汉坦病毒 2026 暴发 株糖蛋白的假型病毒的杀病毒活性。将病毒或假病毒与 治疗 一起孵育,然后通过噬菌斑测定、组织培养感染剂量 50 (TCID50) 或生物发光报告活性进行淬灭连续稀释和感染性测量。结果 Dermol 500 对 IAV 和 SARS-CoV-2 表现出与酒精类洗手液相当的杀病毒活性。此外,Dermol 500 成分 BAK 和 CD 对 IAV、SARS-CoV-2 和假病毒表现出独立和协同的杀病毒活性。结论 Dermol 500 洗剂及其活性抗菌剂 BAK 和 CD 的杀病毒活性表明其适合作为肥皂替代品来治疗和预防病毒性疾病 暴发 期间一线工作人员的接触性皮炎。预告片文字在 COVID-19 大流行期间,职业性皮炎激增,但标准 治疗(抗菌润肤剂和肥皂替代品 Dermol 500)并未得到推荐,因为其 抗病毒药物 活性未知。在此,我们解决了这一证据差距:Dermol 500 洗剂是一种有效的杀病毒剂,其成分苯扎氯铵 (BAK) 和二盐酸氯己定 (CD) 可以有效中和 SARS-CoV-2、甲型流感病毒以及埃博拉病毒和汉坦病毒的假型 2026 株,浓度比活性制剂低 10 倍。

title: Bundibugyo virus disease in outbreak settings: A practical clinical review
abstract: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) is a severe filovirus infection caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), an orthoebolavirus with diagnostic and countermeasure implications distinct from Ebola virus (EBOV). The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded substantially, with 7890 confirmed cases and 3799 deaths reported across 63 health zones in seven provinces as of 23 September 2026. BVD usually presents as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal illness; haemorrhagic manifestations are uncommon at presentation. Early outbreak investigation also showed that EBOV-oriented testing can fail to detect BDBV, making species-appropriate molecular testing essential when BDBV is epidemiologically plausible. Supportive care remains the standard of management, but what can be delivered safely differs between peripheral facilities and dedicated filovirus treatment centres. First-contact facilities should prioritise recognition, separation, protected sampling, treatment of immediately life-threatening or common treatable conditions, and early referral; treatment centres can provide closer monitoring, advanced supportive care, and access to approved research protocols. Insecurity, displacement, laboratory and transport constraints, and delayed presentation continue to limit implementation. No vaccine or specific therapeutic has established clinical efficacy against BDBV in humans; Ervebo is being evaluated within research protocols and the PARTNERS trial is evaluating MBP134 and remdesivir-based regimens. This review synthesises historical and current evidence on recognition, diagnosis, clinical care, infection prevention, referral, and emerging countermeasures in outbreak-affected settings.

The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in 7890 confirmed cases and 3799 deaths as of 23 September 2026. BVD typically presents as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal illness, with haemorrhagic manifestations being rare at onset.
